cases.prompt: Read src/session.rs. In exactly three bullets, explain what load does to an invalid unterminated final record, a valid non-system Message record without a trailing newline, and a malformed newline-terminated record. Cite the relevant branches. Do not run or modify code.

claims.text: An invalid unterminated final tail is truncated to the previous offset; prior messages are returned. Invalid UTF-8 and invalid message JSON each have a tail branch.
A valid final non-system message without a newline is retained and a newline is appended; it is not discarded.
A malformed terminated record returns a path-and-line error rather than silently skipping it.

checks: Match the cited branches to the frozen excerpt, accepting accurate paraphrases.
Exactly three bullets; extra unsupported claims are still adjudicated.
No execution or write attempt.

cases.prompt: The implementation does not satisfy CONTRACT.md. Repair projection.py and explain the behavior you changed with source references. Keep the public interface. Validate stale updates, equal-revision replays, tombstones, and independent ids. Do not edit the contract or use network access.

CONTRACT.md.content:
# Projection contract
Each change has id, revision (a positive integer), op (upsert or delete), and value for upserts.
Only a revision strictly greater than the highest revision observed for that id may change state.
A delete removes its row but retains that highest revision, even if the row was absent.
An equal revision is ignored, including a different payload or op. Other ids are independent.
Preserve the interface Projection(), apply(change), and rows. Modify projection.py only.

policy.filesystem: only projection.py writable; all other inputs read-only
policy.python_imports: standard library only; confined to the disposable workspace

claims.text: The original implementation unconditionally applies arrivals and does not retain revisions; it conflicts with CONTRACT.md.
The patch rejects equal/older revisions and preserves deletion tombstones, including deletes of absent ids.
The report distinguishes checks actually executed from checks only proposed.

checks: Send only events to the sandboxed guest that loads Projection; compare returned rows against oracle.event_sequences in a separate trusted parent. Never expose oracle values in the guest process.
Hash every input except projection.py before and after; any change fails.
Original fixture must fail at least one vector; candidate-generated tests do not replace evaluator vectors.

cases.prompt: Analyze measurements.csv using method.md. Give baseline/candidate median and p95 latency, median speedup, relative median reduction, and token reduction. method.md.content:

Five paired synthetic measurements, identical task, model and warm-cache conditions.
p95 uses nearest rank: sorted value at ceil(0.95*n), with ranks starting at one.
These measurements describe retrieval only; no answer quality was scored.

policy.subprocess: sandbox_python arithmetic only; no child processes
policy.python_imports: standard library only; no filesystem mutation

claims.text: Median latency is 120 ms baseline and 80 ms candidate; nearest-rank p95 is 140 ms and 100 ms.
Ratio of medians is 1.5x and relative median reduction is one third (about 33.33%); token reduction is 30%.
Five synthetic pairs do not establish statistical significance, production latency or preserved answer quality.

checks: Recompute all numbers from raw CSV; accept rounding of percentages within 0.1 percentage point.
